newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia Sucofindo says 1996 net 183.5 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia Sucofindo says 1996 net 183.5 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesia's state-controlled export-import goods surveyor PT Sucofindo said on Friday it posted a net profit of 183.5 billion rupiah in 1996 against 154.4 billion rupiah in 1995.
Sucofindo said in a statement delivered to members of parliament that it expected to post a net profit of 105.8 billion rupiah in 1997.
Sucofindo's contract with the government to conduct overseas customs checks expires on April 1.
Sucofindo said its total assets rose to 434.9 billion rupiah in 1996 against 332.89 billion rupiah in 1995.
The statement did not give further details.
